message:
A1: restore the engine and satisfy the CLI run contract

The previous docs commit dropped engine/ and shared/, so the loop could not run.
`tsx engine/cli.ts run --input --seed --n --out` writes result.json as a RunResult:
designs, every result including constraint rejects, month rows when 50 <= n <= 1000,
leaderDesignId, cliff.relativeDelta, and a StatusBar payload.

Outlay is deposit + fitoutCost only. The six post-2024 quarter rows moved from
shared/constants.ts to data/holdoutQuarters.ts so fitting does not read them
from the frozen contract.

Co-authored-by: devstar2637-hash <devstar2637-hash@users.noreply.github.com>
